Options A 9 B 10 C 11 D 12

Interpretation: sells pencil cases (笔袋) and pens (水笔). Pencil case 12 yuan each, pen 2 yuan each. Promo: buy one pencil case get one pen free. A person paid total 150 yuan, purchased total of pencil cases and pens 35 items (including free gifts). Find number of pencil cases purchased.

Need be careful: "购得笔袋、水笔共35个（含赠品）" total obtained items = pencil cases + pens (including gifted pens) = 35. Paid 150. For each pencil case bought, one free pen. Let x = number of pencil cases bought. Let y = number of pens paid for (not free). Total items: pencil cases x + free pens x + paid pens y = 2x + y = 35. Total paid: 12x + 2y = 150. Solve: y = 35 - 2x. 12x + 2(35-2x)=150 => 12x+70-4x=150 => 8x=80 => x=10. y=15. Answer B.

Check possible ambiguity: "购得笔袋的个数" means bought (paid) pencil cases. Yes.
